item.title: DOJ charges 28 in California with voting crimes as election tensions escalate
item.description: The DOJ also filed an emergency request in federal court to stop California from processing ballots returned by people on the voter rolls the federal government says are "likely noncitizens."

item.title: Judge chastises Trump administration plan to push ahead overhaul of DC golf course
item.description: The Trump administration wants to turn a historic public golf course into championship links. Despite a judge's order, hundreds of trees were cut down to make way for the renovation.

item.title: 'Lincoln in the Bardo' takes a distinctly American grief to the Met stage
item.description: With music by Missy Mazzoli, George Saunders' award-winning Civil War novel comes to surreal life in a stage adaptation making its world premiere at The Metropolitan Opera.

item.title: Australian prime minister says lawmaker critically injured by car is 'no accident'
item.description: A car hit an Australian federal independent lawmaker on Monday, critically injuring her in an apparent deliberate attack, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said. The driver was arrested.

item.title: A Kelvin wave raised sea levels on the West Coast. More are coming
item.description: A large underwater wave moved up the West Coast, raising sea levels. Scientists say it's driven by El Niño and it's going to happen again.
